statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let _J := fun (h : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℂ) => intervalIntegral f (-h) h MeasureTheory.volume; let Jr := fun (h : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral f (-h) h MeasureTheory.volume; let V := fun (n : ℕ) (β : ℝ) => ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 n, E ((k:ℝ)*β); let M := fun (n q : ℕ) (β : ℝ) => ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius q:ℤ):ℂ)/(Nat.totient q:ℂ)*V n β; let H := fun (n q : ℕ) => (105:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ)); let Q := Finset.Icc (1:ℕ) 105; let A := fun (q : ℕ) => (Finset.range q).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q); let B := fun (n : ℕ) => ∑ q ∈ Q, ((A q).card:ℝ) * Jr (H n q) (fun β => ‖M n q β‖^2); let C := fun (n : ℕ) => ∑ q ∈ Q, ∑ a ∈ A q, (_J (H n q) (fun β => (M n q β)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*((a:ℝ)/q+β)))).re; ∀ n : ℕ, 4000000000000000000≤n → 30 ∣ n → (7/2:ℝ)*(n:ℝ) < C n ∧ B n < 6*(n:ℝ)

brief.en: Sum over reduced numerators first. Use FR-9009 for the signed square and the positive reciprocal-totient sum for the energy. FR-9007 and FR-9008 control discretization and truncation.
